title: Fixed-base square column with a 450-degree rotating top

geometry.description: Square column centered on the z axis

discretization.refinement_plan: Compare smaller timesteps and refined meshes before quantitative stress claims.

materials.name: column
materials.provenance: Illustrative parameters; not calibrated to a particular physical material.

time.stability_policy: Explicit fixed dt; implicit convergence failures stop the run; evaluate saved quadrature Jacobians.

allocations.policy: Exact static single-patch topology; no particle or contact capacity.

validation.observable: Unwrapped top rotation across all saved frames
validation.evidence: Independent saved-state evaluator and exact prescribed rigid rotation

invariants.basis: Degree tolerance above float64 trigonometric and cumulative integration roundoff.
Maximum fixed-base and rotating-top coordinate error in metres for exact Dirichlet data.

assumptions: Example geometry and material values are illustrative.
Explicit velocity damping and implicit Newmark numerical dissipation differ.
Validation covers prescribed kinematics and saved-state admissibility, not a static torque benchmark.
